projects.title: Gameboyx
bullets: Built a Game Boy (Color) emulator in C++, coordinating work across 77 files including CPU, PPU and audio subsystems.
Sustained the project across 73 active days and 200 commits, sequencing feature work into stages rather than building everything at once.

projects.title: Chip8 Emulator
bullets: Wrote a Chip8 emulator command-line tool in C and C++ using CMake to manage the 159-file build.

leadership.title: Milestone Coordinator
bullets: After the group's emulator subteam missed a handoff between graphics and audio work, unclear ownership stalled progress for a week.
Set up a shared milestone list assigning one owner per subsystem and a weekly check-in to catch blocked work early.
Found that clarifying ownership unblocked more progress than personally debugging every issue, and started favoring that role.
